query:
INSERT INTO search_events
                       (id, query, door, scope, filters, query_vec, vec_dim, embed_model,
                        created_at, answered, generation_id)
                     VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?,
                             (SELECT id FROM generations WHERE state = 'live'
                               ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1))
